text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Having recovered her condition at the 
resort, Mejiro Ardan once again asks if 
her Trainer is prepared to walk alongside 
someone so fragile, who could break at any 
moment.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In response, to show their resolve as a 
Trainer to never let her break, they 
present a roadmap detailing her future.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ardan accepted this "answer" and 
permitted me to stand beside her as her 
trainer...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, she expressed her resolve to 
the Mejiro family's personal physician, 
obtained permission to return to the 
academy, and came back together with 
Mejiro Ardan.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Leaving the training and race direction of 
her Junior year entirely to her Trainer, 
Mejiro Ardan sets off on a new journey!
